upnp.help: Lets devices on the LAN open ports on the router automatically (games, calls). Changes are staged and applied with rollback.
upnp.secure_mode_help: Devices may only open ports to themselves.
upnp.speed_help: Only reported to clients; it does not limit traffic.
upnp.external_ip_help: Only needed behind another NAT: the router's own WAN address is private there, which disables port mappings.
upnp.no_redirects: No device has opened a port.
upnp.rules_help: Checked in order; the first matching rule decides.
